candidates.notes: Every seed points at a Phase 1.75-reused analysis whose formal record and linkage are byte-identical to what the candidate references. Batch B produced no new reanalysis for these files, so candidate eligibility is untouched; only a human consumption decision on the reused 1.75 additions could change evidence strength later.

seed_policy_review.coverage_evidence: The policy JSON has no coverage/parser_version field; the only coverage statement is free text inside one seed's limitations ('parser captured 1 of 5 @export vars').
gaps: No explicit rule that only formal (non-workspace) analysis may seed a candidate.
No machine-readable coverage-status gate (COMPLETE vs PARTIAL).
seed_policy_review.graph_mechanism: context_relations enumerates the graph-derived relation and candidate context_refs carry counts_as_seed=false / counts_as_implementation_evidence=false.
seed_policy_review.workspace_admissibility_basis: No explicit parser-version rule exists, but every seed is keyed by linkage_id plus the linkage/analysis digests, and linkage records embed the formal analysis digest. An unreviewed workspace reanalysis cannot satisfy those references, so admission is prevented implicitly rather than by an explicit rule.
